how_to_run: Run each prompt in a fresh Alchemy project session with and without the skill. Grade the transcript for search use, reference reads, and verification of version-sensitive claims, not only the final code.

evals.name: cloudflare-durable-object-migration
evals.prompt: our alchemy.run.ts has a cloudflare durable object and i need to rename the class without nuking prod state. work out the resource/migration shape and show the smallest safe change
assertions: Runs scripts/search.py with Durable Object and migration terms
Reads the relevant Cloudflare reference rather than a whole provider bundle
Separates Alchemy configuration from generic Cloudflare behaviour
Verifies any version-sensitive exported names against installed source or current upstream

evals.name: adopt-existing-resource-and-state
evals.prompt: we already have the bucket in aws and alchemy wants to create another one. can we adopt it, and where does the state end up in ci? please inspect the local setup before proposing commands
assertions: Searches separately for resource adoption and state or CI guidance
Reads references for both domains when one page does not own the full answer
Inspects the project before selecting package-manager or CLI commands
Does not invent state defaults from memory

evals.name: test-harness-provider
evals.prompt: my alchemy provider test passes alone but leaks resources in the suite. figure out the intended test harness lifecycle and suggest a behavioural regression test
assertions: Distinguishes documented behaviour from hypotheses about the local leak
Proposes an observable regression test rather than mocking the lifecycle under test

evals.name: blockchain-alchemy-near-miss
evals.prompt: use Alchemy's Ethereum JSON-RPC API to fetch an NFT owner's token balances
assertions: Does not use the vendored alchemy-run infrastructure references
